newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-DUTCH CLEAR LARSSON'S MOVE TO CELTIC.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUTCH CLEAR LARSSON'S MOVE TO CELTIC.

text.p: The Dutch soccer association on Monday settled a dispute between Feyenoord and Henrik Larsson, clearing the way for the Swedish striker to join Scottish side Glasgow Celtic.
The two parties had disagreed over a clause in his contract allowing Larsson to leave for a foreign club for two million guilders ($993,000) before the contract runs out in 1999.
The Dutch FA ruled that Larsson was free to move to Celtic on payment of the sum and encouraged Feyenoord, under threat of a 25,000 guilder ($12,400) penalty per day, not to delay his departure.
If Larsson, 25, moves to Celtic, he will link up with his old coach Wim Jansen who brought him to Feyenoord from Helsingborg in 1993. ($ = 2.012 Dutch Guilders)
